info.title: posd
info.description: The point-of-sale and Lightning address service. The guide, with the signed message formats and how the rails work, is pos/docs/api.md.

servers.description: A brand's public_url, on the posd that serves it. Each brand's domain has its own Lightning addresses.

get.summary: The pay request of a Lightning address (LUD-16).
get.description:
Each brand's domain has its own names: posd tells them apart by the
request's host (see [request_host]).

404.description: No such Lightning address on this domain

post.summary: Gives a store of the operator's brand a Lightning address, reserved or not.
post.description:
A name another store gave up is held for it like any other, and the name
the store had is held for it.

400.description: The name or the Ark address is not valid

401.description: The token is not a brand's admin_token

404.description: No store of the brand has the address

409.description: Another store has or holds the name

post.summary: Reserves names on the operator's domain.
post.description:
A reserved name cannot be taken at registration or by an owner's
change, on that domain only. Reserving a name again, or one a store
already has, changes nothing.

400.description: Too many names, or a name is not valid

401.description: The token is not a brand's admin_token

get.summary:
Makes the invoice for a Lightning address payment (LUD-06 callback), or
gives the address of a LUD-22 method.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: In msat: whole sats, within the pay request's bounds.

parameters.name: payment_method
parameters.description:
LUD-22: methods from `payment_methods`, comma-separated, most
preferred first. The first one the store offers is answered with its
address; with none, or without the field, the answer is an invoice.

200.description: The invoice, or the address of a LUD-22 method

400.description: The amount is out of range or not whole sats

404.description: No such Lightning address on this domain

429.description: Too many unpaid invoices are open; try again in a few minutes

post.summary: Starts an owner login: a challenge for the owner to sign.
post.description:
posd keeps nothing for a challenge: it is authenticated by its last
line, `mac:`, which the owner signs with the rest.

400.description: The address is not a valid Ark address

get.summary: The store's terminals, revoked ones too.

401.description: The token is missing, not valid, or expired

delete.summary: Revokes a terminal. Its next request is `401`.

401.description: The token is missing, not valid, or expired

404.description: No such device in this store

post.summary: Makes a single-use pairing link for a terminal.

401.description: The token is missing, not valid, or expired

post.summary: Finishes an owner login with the signed challenge. A challenge works once.

400.description: The signature does not verify, or the challenge is not posd's, used or expired

404.description: No store is registered for the address

get.summary: The store's sales from every terminal and its Lightning address, newest first.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The id of the last sale of the previous page.

401.description: The token is missing, not valid, or expired

get.summary: The store's sales as CSV, with the columns of the terminal's export.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: A date (`2026-11-20`, in UTC) or an RFC 3339 time.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: A date or an RFC 3339 time. A date includes that whole day.

401.description: The token is missing, not valid, or expired
The token is missing, not valid, or expired

400.description: A field is not valid, or posd does not serve the brand

401.description: The token is missing, not valid, or expired

409.description: The Lightning address name is taken, reserved or held on the store's domain

post.summary: Pairs a terminal with a pairing code. A code works once.

200.description: The device token and its store

400.description: The device name is not valid

404.description: The code is unknown, used or expired

get.summary: The bitcoin price in the store's currency.

401.description: The token is missing, not valid, or revoked

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The id of the last sale of the previous page.

401.description: The token is missing, not valid, or revoked

post.description:
With an `Idempotency-Key`, a request repeated with the same key and body,
as after a response lost on a poor network, returns the sale of the
first request instead of making another.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per sale on the device.

400.description: The amount, memo or key is not valid

401.description: The token is missing, not valid, or revoked

409.description: The key was used with a different body, or `currency` is not the store's

502.description: The price feed or the Ark server failed

get.description:
The columns are `id, created_at, paid_at, state, paid_rail, amount_sat,
received_sat, fiat_amount, currency, btc_price, memo, device_name`.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: A date (`2026-11-20`, in UTC) or an RFC 3339 time.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: A date or an RFC 3339 time. A date includes that whole day.

401.description: The token is missing, not valid, or revoked

get.summary: A sale of the terminal's store, at once or by long-poll.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description:
Hold the request until the sale is no longer in this state, for at
most 25 seconds. Repeat it with the last state seen to follow a sale.

parameters.name: onchain_sat
parameters.description:
With `wait`, also return when `onchain_received_sat +
onchain_pending_sat` is no longer this, so a terminal sees a partial
payment arrive.

401.description: The token is missing, not valid, or revoked

404.description: No such sale in this store

post.description:
posd first checks the sale's on-chain address, then asks barkd to cancel
the Lightning invoice. barkd forgets an unpaid invoice; the Ark server
keeps it payable until it expires. When a payment was made or is
arriving, the sale is not canceled: it is `409`, and the sale soon shows
its new state.

401.description: The token is missing, not valid, or revoked

404.description: No such sale in this store

409.description: The sale is not open, or a payment for it was made

502.description: The chain source or barkd failed; the sale stays open

post.summary: Gives a sale its on-chain address, when the cashier picks on-chain.
post.description:
A sale gets one address, so repeating the request returns the same one.
A payer who already paid part of the amount to it sees the full amount
in `onchain_uri`; the terminal shows what arrived from
`onchain_received_sat` and `onchain_pending_sat`.

200.description: The sale, with its on-chain address

401.description: The token is missing, not valid, or revoked

404.description: No such sale in this store

409.description: The sale is not open, is below the store's on-chain minimum, or the store has no unused address

post.summary: Registers a store, signed by the owner's Ark key.
post.description:
The signed message is these lines, joined by `\n`, with no trailing
newline: `posd registration v1`, then `name:`, `ark_address:`,
`onchain_descriptor:`, `silent_payment_address:`, `currency:`, `brand:`,
`lightning_address_name:` and `timestamp:`, each followed by its field.

400.description: The signature, timestamp, address, descriptor, silent payment address, currency, brand or Lightning address name is not valid

409.description: A store is registered for the address, or the Lightning address name is taken, reserved or held

401.description: The token is missing, not valid, or revoked

ark_address.description: The store's Ark address, as registered.

BrandKey.description:
The key of a brand, as in `[brands.<key>]`: 1 to 32 lowercase letters,
digits and `-`.

CallbackReply.description:
An invoice, or with a LUD-22 method an address, keyed by the method:
`{"ARK": {"address": "ark1…"}}`. Tell them apart by their shape.

pr.description:
The forwarding invoice. It carries the metadata's text description,
not its hash: the Ark server cannot put a hash in an invoice.

challenge.description: The text to sign. It works once, within 5 minutes.

CreateSale.description: A new sale. Give exactly one of `fiat_amount` and `amount_sat`.

currency.description:
The currency the terminal showed `fiat_amount` in. When it is not the
store's, as after the owner changed it, the sale is refused with
`409` instead of charging in another currency.

fiat_amount.description: A decimal in the store's currency, with at most its decimal places.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error response.

error.description: What went wrong, for people. Internal and upstream errors say only that.

url.description: The pairing link, on the store's brand's domain.

LnurlErrorBody.description:
The body of an LNURL error, as LUD-06 has it, so the payer's wallet
shows the reason.

reason.example: the amount is out of range

signature.description: The hex BIP 340 signature of the challenge with bark's message signing.

token.description: The owner token. posd keeps only its hash, so it is shown once.

MethodAddress.description: A LUD-22 address, for the amount of the callback.

ark_address.description: The registered Ark address, whose key owns the store.

next_onchain_index.description:
The next derivation index posd gives a sale from `onchain_descriptor`.
Every index below it may have been shown to a payer: a wallet that
restores the account scans at least that far, and gives none of
those addresses out for its own receives.

OwnerStoreView.description:
How a store looks to its owner: what a terminal sees, and what the
owner's wallet needs to keep its accounts in step with posd.

code.description: The code from the pairing link `/pair/<code>`.

device_name.description: 1 to 64 characters, shown to the owner and on receipts.

token.description: The device token. posd keeps only its hash, so it is shown once.

maxSendable.description: In msat, set in the posd config.

metadata.description: The LUD-06 metadata, a JSON array as a string.

payment_methods.description:
LUD-22: the methods besides Lightning that the callback can return
an address for. `SP` only when the owner registered a silent payment
address.
Named as LUD-22 names it, not in the camelCase of LUD-06.

Rail.description: The rail that paid a sale.

btc_price.description: The price of one bitcoin in `currency`.

signature.description:
The hex BIP 340 signature of the registration message by the key of
`ark_address`, with bark's message signing.

Registration.description:
The fields of a store registration. The owner signs [Registration::message]
of them.

ark_address.description: The Ark address that receives the payments. Its key owns the store.

brand.description:
The key of the store's brand in posd's config: its terminals' look
and the domain of its Lightning address and pairing links.

currency.description: A currency posd's price source quotes, such as `USD` or `CRC`.

lightning_address_name.description:
The name of the store's Lightning address on the brand's domain, if
it wants one. Empty or absent for none.

onchain_descriptor.description: The public descriptor of the on-chain account the host app keeps.

silent_payment_address.description:
The owner's BIP 352 silent payment address, which the store's
Lightning address offers to payers that support it. Empty or absent
for none.

timestamp.description: Seconds since the UNIX epoch, within 10 minutes of posd's clock.

reserved.description: How many of the names were newly reserved.

SaleState.description:
The state of a sale. `paid`, `expired` and `canceled` are final; an
`in-progress` sale has an on-chain payment in the mempool.

SaleView.description: The sale as the API shows it.

btc_price.description: The price of one bitcoin in `currency` the sale used.

expires_at.description:
When an `open` sale expires. An `in-progress` sale stays so past it
until its payment confirms.

fiat_amount.description:
The amount keyed in, as a decimal in `currency`. `null` for a sale
keyed in sats.

id.description: Random, so that sales cannot be enumerated.

onchain_available.description:
Whether the sale can be paid on-chain: a terminal's sale of at least
the store's `onchain_min_sat`. The address is made when the cashier
picks on-chain, with `POST /sales/{id}/onchain`.

onchain_pending_sat.description:
In the mempool to the on-chain address. With `onchain_received_sat`
and an `open` sale, a partial payment: the payer still owes the rest.

onchain_received_sat.description: Confirmed to the on-chain address so far.

onchain_uri.description:
The address and the sale's amount as a BIP 21 URI, `null` with the
address. It keeps the full amount after a partial payment.

received_sat.description: Higher than `amount_sat` when the payer overpaid or paid both rails.

Store.description: How a store looks to the API.

brand.description: The key of the store's brand in posd's config.

currency_decimals.description: The decimal places a sale in `currency` may have.

lightning_address.description:
`null` when the store has none. Its domain is the host of the
brand's public URL.

min_sale_sat.description:
The smallest sale, in sats: below it the Ark server's Lightning
receive fee would take the whole amount. It follows the server's fees.

onchain_min_sat.description: Sales below this many sats offer no on-chain address.

UpdateStore.description: The fields to change. Fields left out stay as they are.

lightning_address_name.description:
1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, `.`, `-` and `_`. An empty name
removes the Lightning address. A name the store gives up, by a new
name, an empty one or a move to another brand, is held for it for 90
days: no other store can take it, and the store can take it back.

admin_token.description: A brand's admin_token from the posd config.

device_token.description: The device token a terminal gets from pairing.

owner_token.description: The owner token from a signed login. It lasts 24 hours.
